cost_responsibility.scope: operations, wayfinding, temporary furniture and staffed service
cost_responsibility.exit: remove equipment and retain non-digital service

cost_responsibility.scope: accessibility repairs, limited ground-floor opening, shade and rain garden

cost_responsibility.scope: adaptive building repair, energy and facility renewal
cost_responsibility.lead: property/site host and qualified delivery body
cost_responsibility.exit: full-life-cycle maintenance, replacement and removal ledger

cost_responsibility.scope: crossing, trunk utilities and permanent new construction
cost_responsibility.exit: no commitment or early construction before formal approval

stop_triggers: material displacement or loss of public benefit

inclusion_rights.right: continuous accessible journey and multi-channel information
inclusion_rights.required_alternative: human assistance, tactile/high-contrast guidance and passable route without digital service

inclusion_rights.right: equal access without QR code or app
inclusion_rights.required_alternative: telephone, paper guidance and staffed counter

inclusion_rights.right: no identity collection and visible caregiving
inclusion_rights.required_alternative: physical play, stroller route and switchable interaction
low-level lighting, staffed help point and clear emergency route

inclusion_rights.right: participation in design and protected service access
inclusion_rights.required_alternative: manual maintenance mode and unobstructed logistics route

roles.responsibility: rules, cross-department coordination and public-benefit baseline
space, utilities, daily maintenance and access continuity
staffing, service quality, logs, complaints and shutdown
accessibility, resident, legal, data, heritage and planning review

funding_ledger: public or philanthropic funds: universal access, basic public space, safety and inclusive service baseline
site host: building repair, utilities and routine maintenance
pilot sponsor or research team: equipment, testing, security assessment, insurance and removal
enterprise service and training revenue: may cross-subsidize public operations but not monetize personal data or basic passage
delivery_model.required_before_permanence: full-life-cycle ledger covering construction, operations, replacement and removal; no invented investment amount

evaluation_protocol.baseline: at least one complete weekday/weekend cycle before intervention
prohibited: facial recognition as a substitute for spatial safety

permanence_gates: verified spatial, rail, road, heritage, property and fire-safety conditions
continuous accessibility and equal non-digital access
lawful minimum data, visible AI disclosure, complaint and deletion rights
public benefit demonstrated against baseline without shifting harm to minority users
named accountable operator and sustainable full-life-cycle funding
no demonstrated displacement of existing residents, small businesses, low-cost innovation space or free public access

first_implementation_cell.status: research window pending survey, ownership and approvals
minimum_components: one existing indoor ground-floor room that may be opened by agreement

engineering_levels.scope: audit, route organization, staffed service, temporary programming and baseline
reversible seating, light canopy, service table, rain planter and non-digital guidance
adaptive reuse of existing ground floor, heritage interface repair and long-term public service

public_art_system.purpose: make engineering time, community memory and civic judgment perceptible without turning the corridor into a technology spectacle
shared_rules: do not obstruct railway heritage views or continuous accessible passage
no ambient listening, biometric surveillance or compulsory digital participation
reversible installation with named maintenance responsibility
when interaction is switched off, each work remains useful as seating, guidance, lighting or a public table
